name: Zaggle Prepaid Ocean Services Ltd
tagline: High-growth fintech-SaaS spend-management platform still winning marquee logos, but a third straight quarter of profit pressure and unresolved cash-conversion concerns keep conviction Low
business_overview: B2B spend-management / employee-benefits SaaS (Zaggle Save, Propel, expense management) for enterprises; grows via direct sales plus acquisitions (Dice, Unobanc stake).
fundamentals_table: 5-yr Zaggle Save agreement with Crompton Greaves Consumer (usage-linked, value not quantifiable)
fundamentals_narrative: Revenue growth is still well above the industry median (+27.5% YoY) but Q1 FY27 PAT fell 33% and adjusted EBITDA margin compressed to 8.2%, which management attributes to one-time Dice acquisition costs (transaction fees, vendor payments, relocation). The prior read's cash-flow / rising-receivables / investor-communication concerns have not been resolved. The Crompton Greaves 5-year deal is a real logo win but carries no quantifiable contract value.
sentiment_summary: One new post (#448, shyamutty, elevated tier): Vijay Kedia's Kedia Securities bought ~20 lakh shares via a bulk deal at ~Rs 164.72 - a marquee-investor entry, reported not endorsed. Otherwise the prior debate (cash flow, receivables, disclosure quality, FII exits) stands.
community_signal: shyamutty (elevated) flagged the Kedia bulk deal without a personal call. No trusted-roster buy conviction; prior concerns from firefueled / anna / rosenmund remain on the table.
key_new_facts: Sovrenn lead verified: 5-year agreement with Crompton Greaves Consumer Electricals for Zaggle Save; value is MAU/spend-linked and 'cannot be determined at this stage'.
Q1 FY27: revenue Rs 423 Cr (+27.5% YoY), PAT Rs 17.5 Cr (-33% YoY), adj EBITDA margin 8.2% (down from 10.1%), blamed on one-time Dice acquisition costs.
Kedia Securities acquired ~20 lakh shares via bulk deal (~Rs 164.72 avg).
bull_case: Revenue still compounding ~27-28% with a large structural SaaS niche
Marquee logo additions (Crompton Greaves 5-yr) and marquee-investor entry (Kedia)
bear_case: Third consecutive quarter of profit pressure; Q1 FY27 PAT -33% YoY even if partly one-off
Cash conversion, rising receivables and investor-communication concerns from the prior read remain unaddressed
Crompton deal has no quantifiable value
verdict_headline: Re-verification: the Crompton Greaves deal is a genuine logo win but unquantified, and Q1 FY27 shows profit still under pressure - thesis_fit 10x-in-2-3-years (unconfirmed) at Low conviction, unchanged
verdict_reasoning: Re-verification stock (Sovrenn lead). The Crompton Greaves 5-year Zaggle Save agreement is verified but explicitly has no determinable contract value, so it does not by itself move conviction.

Q1 FY27 (PAT -33% YoY, margin 8.2%) confirms the execution-quality concerns from the prior read rather than dispelling them, even allowing for one-time Dice costs; the Kedia Securities bulk-deal entry is a mild offsetting positive.

No change: thesis_fit 10x-in-2-3-years kept as unconfirmed on the small-cap size and structural niche; conviction Low given the recurring cash-conversion and disclosure concerns. No red flag; no 30-day revisit.

trusted_signals.thread: Zaggle_A platform to address pain points for enterprises
trusted_signals.note: Reported Kedia Securities' ~20 lakh-share bulk-deal purchase at ~Rs 164.72 - information share, not a personal conviction call.

four_box.note: Enterprise fintech/expense-management SaaS niche is a real structural market; revenue still compounding ~27-28% YoY supports tam despite margin pressure; no distinct competitive moat described (Crompton deal has no quantifiable contract value) — no; unresolved cash-conversion/rising-receivables concerns for a third consecutive quarter of profit pressure — valuation weak, no clear cheap/expensive signal.
